title: Build the first model evidence record
mission: Produce a reproducible comparison showing how evidence quality and training controls change a learned line.

starting_state.known_good_state: Default controls produce a stable line near the hidden linear relationship.

guided.objective: Run and interpret the known-good baseline.
steps: Compare the line with the evidence
guided.expected_observation: Weight approaches the hidden relationship and test loss remains finite.

challenge.objective: Produce and diagnose three distinct failure conditions.
steps: Change one control at a time
Record slow, unstable, and data-quality runs
challenge.expected_observation: Each controlled change produces a distinct visible diagnosis.

engineer_extension.objective: Compare iterative fitting with a direct least-squares reference.
steps: Calculate both solutions under identical data
engineer_extension.expected_observation: Both methods agree within an explicitly selected tolerance.

failure_experiment.change: Increase learning rate until updates diverge.
failure_experiment.prediction: Loss grows and the line moves farther from useful evidence.
failure_experiment.failure_signal: The interface reports instability and non-improving loss.
failure_experiment.recovery: Restore the documented default learning rate and rerun.

acceptance_criteria: A normal run and failed run are reproducible from recorded settings.
Training and test results are reported separately.
The explanation distinguishes parameters from experiment controls.
recovery: Use Reset defaults before comparing runs.
Change only one control between recorded experiments.
